sections.title: Player-facing description
sections.body: The predator in the trees is wolf-shaped until it turns its owl face toward you. Feathers ripple through the ruff, and the amber eyes do not blink.

sections.title: Handout text
sections.body: Player-safe note: A wild adult owl-wolf with a feathered ruff, lupine body, owl face, amber hunting eyes, and a low stalking posture that turns silence into a warning.
